# a command reported success while its receipt was silently quarantined

`develop.started` was written to `events/_quarantine/` with code UNKNOWN_KIND, because the
spine's vocabulary is closed. The emitting command exited 0.

A receipt that never landed, reported as success. Found only by listing the spine directory
by hand, four steps later.
